Clinic: 4,200 patients, 6 rooms; open 08:00–19:00 weekdays, 09:00–13:00 Saturday. Twelve nurses in three shifts, four admin staff. Accreditation runs to April 2027; renewal needs an infection-control audit.

Attendance averages 180/day, peaking at 310 in the January 2025 flu wave. No-shows are 9%, down from 14% after September 2024 reminder texts.

Key rules: no prescription renewal without a consultation in the past 12 months; vaccine stock counted twice weekly; temperature excursions above 8°C reported same day. A networked fridge alarm plus paper backup followed a March 2024 failure; record-locking followed a November 2024 allergy-field overwrite.

Open items: the ultrasound utilisation study is outstanding, and the nursing coordinator post, vacant since August 2025, is covered by two senior nurses only until winter.
